intro.text: A young barmaid at Jez's Duty in the Ten Rings section of Urithiru.

items.text: On the day of Jor and Kryst's wedding party, Mel served Adolin, Shallan and Kaladin. Puzzled that Kaladin ordered only orange, she kept offering him yellow; Veil chased her off, and when she offered again, Adolin declined for him. Mel beamed, thrilled that a highprince had spoken to her.
